skater_rank_basis: What happened this season. Ranked by on-ice impact (SOAI), which includes the team and system a player plays in. For skill separated from team, and for trade targets, use the Predictive tab. Players without current-season minutes are not ranked here.
fantasy_rank_basis: In-season 2026-2027 fantasy board, updated every night (30% of the season played). Category totals are the full season: what each player has recorded so far plus a projection of the rest of the season. The projection blends the preseason forecast with the player's own season to date -- ice time, games and every scoring rate -- each weighted by how much of the season he has actually played, at speeds fitted on past seasons (hits settle in a few games, goals and assists take much longer). Rank follows projected rest-of-season fantasy value.
goalie_fantasy_rank_basis: Next-season (2027-2028) goalie forecast from completed seasons; an in-season goalie update (results to date plus the rest of the season) is not validated yet, so this table does not reflect this season's play. Goalie workload and rates are forecast separately in strict rolling-origin tests. The final two completed seasons are retired diagnostics and cannot select the model. Fantasy Score uses 4 per win, 0.2 per save, -2 per goal allowed and 3 per shutout; raw categories remain sortable for other league formats.
goalie_rank_basis: Season-to-date goalie performance. The default rank uses total shot-quality-adjusted goals saved above expected so workload and performance both count; per-60, save percentage, expected save percentage and penalty-kill results remain sortable context. Empty-net shots are excluded and goalies need at least min(10, ceil(10% of an 82-game season)) starts to qualify.
underrated_rank_basis: Talent, role, and context statistics are combined into an underplayed score. Metrics are heavily weighted toward the current season, but use the last 3 seasons to assign certainty. Fits and models are trained solely on data available through the public NHL API. All analysis on this page excludes empty-net goals unless otherwise specified. Metrics are also shrunk based on certainty and stability, so it may take several games for a player to be appropriately ranked.

scoring_anomalies.basis: Minimum 10 total points for point-profile tables and minimum 8 total goals for 5v5 goal-share. Points are derived from season goal events. 5v5 means exact 5 skaters vs 5 skaters with goalies on ice. Power-play points include all man-advantage goal points with a goalie in net. 5v5 + PP can be less than total because shorthanded, 4v4, 3v3, and extra-attacker situations are separate. 1-goal games use the final goal margin from season goal events.

recent_basis: Recent mover lists use custom rating changes versus the 2026-11-03 snapshot, which is the day before the weighted-median 10th most recent team game. Skater movers use overall talent score, team movers use total team score, goalie movers use goalie score, and usage lists compare the most recent 10 games to the previous 10.
